rule_summary: UPPCO Rate Book #8, Distributed Generation Rider (DG), Sheets D-72.80 to D-72.85, eff. 03-13-25 (MPSC Case U-21791). Legacy Net Metering (tariffs PG-NM, PG-2, PG-3) closed to new customers; legacy participants may continue for 10 years from original participation date (MCL 460.1183; MCL 460.6a(14)), then must transition to DG Rider. Combined Net Metering + DG Program size capped at discretionary 10.0% of UPPCO's average peak demand over past 5 years; at least 50% reserved for Category 1 (<=20kW) and not more than 50% for Category 2 (>20-550kW). Outflow credit (unlike DTE's LMP-based rate) carries forward indefinitely as a bill credit rather than cashing out monthly - 'Any excess credit not used will be carried forward to subsequent billing periods' - a deviation from the state-row's monthly-netting default.
nem_aggregate_cap: As of 2023 MPSC RE-DG report: Category 1 (<=20kW) 68% subscribed (2340 of 7290 kW allocated); Category 2 (>20-550kW) 99.2% subscribed (61 of ~61.6 kW allocated) - Category 2 nearly full.

rule_summary: Standard Contract Rider No. 18, Distributed Generation Program (M.P.S.C. No. 1 - Electric, Sheets D-111 to D-116, Case No. U-20162, orig. eff. May 2019; cap and sizing figures below reflect the 2019 baseline tariff and have not been independently re-verified against post-PA235 (2023) revised sheets - see gaps file). Full-service customers on non-time-based schedules credited for Outflow at the monthly average real-time LMP at the DTE Electric load node; credit offsets only power supply/PSCR charges, not delivery charges. Program also imposes a System Access Contribution (SAC) charge of $2.31/kW-AC/month (residential) or $2.28/kW-AC/month (secondary commercial, no demand charge) on DG Rider participants attached to secondary rate schedules - functions as a de facto standby/grid-access charge not present in the base state rule.

rule_summary: Cooperative, not subject to MPSC net-metering/DG-rate rules (co-ops exempt from PA 341/342 rate provisions) but voluntarily follows the MIXDG interconnection Levels 1-5 (R 460.901-460.992) for the technical interconnection process. Cloverland's DER Standard Operating Procedures (CEC-SOP-23-03) credit Level 1/2 (<=150 kWAC) excess generation at the FULL RETAIL RATE (not an unbundled/avoided-cost/LMP rate) - a materially more favorable compensation basis than the DTE/Consumers unbundled-generation approach. Credit excludes fixed facility/demand charges. Net Excess Generation (NEG) credits carry forward indefinitely and do not expire (true indefinite rollover, unlike DTE's monthly-netting approach). Level 3-5 (>150kW) generation is separately negotiated or sold on the open market.

rule_summary: Municipal utility, not subject to MPSC MIXDG rate rules; sets own Distributed Generation program. Customer billed on total inflow at applicable rate, minus outflow credits for exported energy. All outflow credited at HBPW's own 'Distributed Energy Value' (rate not published in source reviewed), which can offset energy, delivery, capacity, and readiness-to-serve charges (broader offset than DTE/Consumers, which restrict credit to power-supply-only). Legacy Net Metering customers (enrolled, or application received before 7/1/2019) grandfathered at prior net-metering rates for 10 years from initial application date.

rule_summary: Standard Contract Rider No. 16, Excess Distributed Generation (EDG), IURC Cause No. 45911, Original No. 172, eff. 5/9/2024. Rate updated annually by compliance filing due March 1. Enrollment began 7/1/2022 (post-SEA 309 net metering closure). Nameplate cap: lesser of 1 MW or customer's average annual consumption. Excludes Rider 9 (legacy net metering) facilities. Net inflow billed at standard rate; net outflow (EDG) credited and carried forward indefinitely as an account credit (not cash-out monthly) until account closure, at which point unused credit flows through the fuel adjustment clause (FAC) to all customers.
export_credit_value: 3.9350 cents/kWh (effective 7/1/2024; average marginal price of energy paid by AES Indiana in prior calendar year x 1.25 per IC 8-1-40-17; updated annually)
storage_specific_notes: Storage-specific treatment not addressed separately in Rider 16 text reviewed; battery-inclusive systems' EDG eligibility follows the 'nameplate capacity' definition (full load continuous rating, or lower of inverter/aggregate inverter rating for inverter-based systems) - unclear whether battery power rating is included in this figure for EDG-cap purposes.

rule_summary: NIPSCO offers TWO closed/legacy programs distinct from the standard EDG structure used by the other IOUs: (1) legacy Feed-in Tariff (closed to new applicants) for solar/wind/biomass/small-hydro, sized 5kW-5MW, with a total programwide capacity of 30 MW (no single technology >15 MW; 700 kW carve-out for solar <10kW, 300kW for wind <10kW) - this program is fully subscribed/closed. (2) A Distributed Generation Tariff Program, functionally similar to the standard IN EDG rate, crediting excess generation at 125% of the market price for power. New customers today enroll under the standard EDG rate/state default, not the closed Feed-in Tariff.
